note: The malformed TRY field from the .aff file is copied into the AffixMgr try string; in this candidate the field is a single invalid UTF-8 leading byte.
The parsed .aff TRY string is retrieved from the AffixMgr and passed toward suggestion manager construction.
The invalid UTF-8 TRY bytes become the SuggestMgr candidate character string used for later UTF-8 suggestion generation.
u8_u16 returns -1 on the invalid UTF-8 TRY byte, but the result is stored in unsigned size_t ctryl instead of being checked, so ctryl no longer matches ctry_utf.size().
The fuzz word is not in the dictionary, causing the constructed SuggestMgr with corrupted ctryl to generate suggestions.
The loop is bounded by the corrupted ctryl value rather than the actual ctry_utf vector length.
When j advances past the one replacement element produced by u8_u16, this reads beyond the ctry_utf vector.
